_note: TIDELINE house style and art direction only. data/wiseman.json is shared by all three directions, so the two area blurbs that carry American spelling and a straight apostrophe are patched here rather than in the shared feed, and so is the photograph each area leads on. scripts/build_site.py merges this over data['areas'] for this direction alone. The prose is VERBATIM from the feed: spelling and punctuation change, nothing else. The image keys are art direction, chosen against data/artdirection.json and against what the CDN can actually deliver at full-bleed width; imageAlt describes the frame that is there. Never add a claim here.

brentwood.body: San Vicente Boulevard runs through the middle of it, the coral trees down its median designated a Los Angeles Historic‑Cultural Monument and the grass beside them used as the neighbourhood’s running track. The Brentwood Country Mart, the Sunday farmers market and the Getty Center are all within a short drive.
brentwood.imageAlt: Gretna Green Harlow, a long low building under palms in Brentwood.

venice.body: Abbot Kinney Boulevard and Rose Avenue are the neighbourhood’s two commercial spines; the canals, the Penmar golf course and the beach path are all within a short ride.
venice.imageAlt: Venice Wave on Venice Boulevard, seen through street trees.

west-la.imageAlt: Santa Monica Breeze on Purdue Avenue in West Los Angeles, shops at street level.

beverly-grove.imageAlt: Orlando on First, a navy and white elevation in Beverly Grove.

hollywood.imageAlt: Wilcox Melrose, a dark facade with a red entrance court off Melrose Avenue.

palms.imageAlt: Motor Tides on Motor Avenue, stacked glass balconies against the sky.

glendale.imageAlt: 220 East Broadway in Glendale at nightfall, street lights and traffic trails across the corner.
